intent.subtype: blocking assignments to registers in a clocked block
intent.rationale: stage1 and stage2 are written with = in always_ff, so the second stage sees the new first stage and the pipe collapses to one stage while valid is delayed two.

labels.note: Blocking assignments in always_ff: stage2 = stage1 sees the just-written stage1, collapsing the two-stage delay to one, and stage2 is read outside the block.
labels.other: LC23 line 16: stage1/stage2 have no reset while their valid peers do

labels.note: Blocking writes to state in always_ff: stage2 takes the new stage1 value the same cycle, so the two-stage delay collapses to one and misaligns with valid_out.
